bugs.root_cause: Property access on potentially null/undefined value
bugs.fix: Added null safety (optional chaining or null check)

bugs.root_cause: JSONEncoder key order is not stable; the test matched a literal key order

bugs.error_message: Circle alert corners not transparent, box visible around rounded HUD
bugs.root_cause: NSVisualEffectView rounded via layer cornerRadius: blur and window shadow stay rectangular
bugs.fix: effect.maskImage = stretchable rounded-rect image (capInsets); panel.display() + invalidateShadow() after ordering in

bugs.error_message: SettingsWindowTests: XCTAssertLessThan failed (720.0 not less than 0.0) - must stay off screen
bugs.root_cause: orderFrontRegardless constrains a titled window back onto a display; -30000 origin is not safe
bugs.fix: Never order the test window in; layoutIfNeeded + cacheDisplay; assert !isVisible

bugs.error_message: Cmd+Q / Cmd+W do nothing in settings window
bugs.root_cause: Agent app built without NSApp.mainMenu; key equivalents come only from the main menu
bugs.fix: AppDelegate.mainMenu(): Close Window (Cmd+W, performClose) and Quit Batteries (Cmd+Q, terminate)

bugs.error_message: Notification shows generic white icon though Finder shows AppIcon.icns
bugs.root_cause: IconServices system cache (/Library/Caches/com.apple.iconservices.store) stored the generic icon for com.akim.batteries when the first notifications went out before the app had an icon. Survives reboot, bundle version bump, killall NotificationCenter. Proven: same icon under a fresh bundle ID showed correctly.
bugs.fix: Owner deleted /Library/Caches/com.apple.iconservices.store (sudo) and restarted. Asset catalog (Assets.car + CFBundleIconName) kept: modern format, harmless.

bugs.error_message: Widget missing from gallery; BatteriesWidget crashes EXC_BREAKPOINT in ExtensionFoundation closure in _EXRunningExtension._shared (from _EXExtension.bootstrap via BatteryWidget.$main); chronod: descriptor query failed NSCocoaErrorDomain 4099
bugs.root_cause: SwiftPM linked the widget with entry point main. Xcode links extensions with -e _NSExtensionMain, which runs ExtensionMain.start (sets the extension type) before the @main Widget; without it ExtensionMain.shared is empty and the force-unwrap traps.
bugs.fix: BatteriesWidget linkerSettings add -Xlinker -e -Xlinker _NSExtensionMain. Found by comparing nm -u with a working Developer ID widget (BetterTouchTool imports _NSExtensionMain).

bugs.error_message: usbmuxd Listen: Result Number 0 but no Attached/Detached events ever
bugs.root_cause: Listen request lacked kLibUSBMuxVersion; usbmuxd (macOS 27.2.1) then accepts and stays silent
bugs.fix: Send ["MessageType": "Listen", "kLibUSBMuxVersion": 3] like libusbmuxd; Attached arrives at once for each connected phone
